findings.detail: The table claims 285 seconds of execution plus 15 seconds of cleanup. With the current 300-second parent budget, allocation_budget(300, 285) reserves 15 seconds for the parent and two 15-second child cleanup phases, leaving at most 255 seconds for execution. A maintainer investigating a document timeout could therefore expect 30 seconds more execution than the driver permits.
findings.fix: Replace the table entry with: "Requests 285 s; allocation permits at most 255 s execution, 30 s child cleanup and 15 s enclosing cleanup within 300 s." Update the matching description at lines 42–43.
findings.title: Uncited: The documented execution allowance exceeds the allocated budget.
